# Instruction

This is the project research for building and integrating multimodal model for price prediction in vietnamese Financial Chatbot. 
Main goal of the project is to have a chatbot can analyse and predict the price using Cross-modal temporal fusion between structure market information OHLCV ,unstructure news and extend to other media such as company reports.

# Rule must follow
- always ask before working for clear answering, DO NOT work on asumption.
- clean your mess: only modify code in simplification style and remove redundant not wired code and 1 time run code after using.
- always check the logic have been applied or not or just code surface changed.
